santorini.scope: Santorini and the Cyclades as a whole. Santorini itself has no real surf: Monolithos beach is used for kitesurfing and wing foiling, and wind chop is not swell. The only documented surf in the island group is small, beginner-friendly summer windswell from the meltemi on north-facing beaches of Tinos (Kolymbithra, where a surf school runs, and Livada), a long ferry from Santorini. Waves are knee-high and rarely above shoulder height, and there can be months with nothing ridable. Owner decision, 17 Oct 2026: this is NOT a not-applicable place. Give it a very low score (best months well under 2), with the honest message that surf is a side note here.
